title: FastRoverVLA: Fast Vision-Language-Action Execution for Off-Road Autonomous Driving
title_zh: FastRoverVLA：面向越野自动驾驶的快速视觉-语言-动作执行
abstract_en: Off-road vision-language-action (VLA) models generate scene-conditioned plans, but frequent trajectory updates can repeatedly invoke expensive multimodal inference. Reusing a prediction reduces this demand while leaving its commands exposed to changes in vehicle motion. FastRoverVLA addresses this mismatch by decoupling visual plan generation from motion-conditioned execution. Its training-free interface maintains decoded plans between visual predictions. A speed-curvature action buffer is aligned with measured motion at each update, integrated into a local trajectory, and advanced by consuming the current action. The corrected remainder is written back to the buffer, preserving motion corrections across successive updates. A bounded refresh rule normalizes speed and curvature variations within a newly decoded plan and assigns a short or long reuse budget according to the resulting plan-roughness score. The interface requires neither backbone features nor an additional learned driving policy. Over a 3 s horizon, independent real-request evaluation achieves average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) of 0.328/0.596 m on ORAD-3D and 0.266/0.526 m on RELLIS-3D, reducing FDE by 18.0% and 36.7% at request rates of 6.0% and 4.8%, respectively. These runs retain lower errors across four backbones and both datasets and reduce Qwen3-VL request-processing cost by factors of 16.6 and 20.8 under serial replay, while mechanism and motion-only controls identify persistent state correction as the main source of the observed accuracy benefit. The source code and evaluation materials are publicly available at https://github.com/ADEPT-ORG/FastRoverVLA.
abstract_zh: 越野自动驾驶中的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型根据场景生成驾驶计划，但频繁更新轨迹会反复触发高成本的多模态推理；直接复用计划又难以适应车辆运动状态的变化。FastRoverVLA 将视觉计划生成与基于实测运动的执行解耦。其免训练接口在两次视觉推理之间维护速度–曲率动作缓冲区：每次更新时，先根据实测运动校正缓冲区，再将动作积分为局部轨迹，执行并移除当前动作，最后写回校正后的剩余动作，使校正效果延续到后续更新。刷新规则对新计划中的速度和曲率变化进行归一化，并按计划粗糙度选择较短或较长的复用周期。该接口无需访问骨干模型的内部特征，也无需额外训练驾驶策略。在 3 秒预测时域的独立实际请求评估中，ORAD-3D 上的平均位移误差（ADE）和终点位移误差（FDE）分别为 0.328 m 和 0.596 m，RELLIS-3D 上分别为 0.266 m 和 0.526 m；两者的模型请求率分别为 6.0% 和 4.8%，FDE 分别降低 18.0% 和 36.7%。误差优势在四种骨干模型和两个数据集上均得到保持。在串行回放中，Qwen3-VL 在两个数据集上的请求处理成本分别降至原来的 1/16.6 和 1/20.8。机制消融及仅使用运动信息的对照实验表明，持续保留状态校正是精度提升的主要来源。代码和评估材料已公开。
key_points_zh: 将高成本的视觉计划生成与高频轨迹更新解耦，无需重新训练、访问骨干模型内部特征或引入额外驾驶策略。
每次更新都用实测运动校正速度–曲率动作缓冲区，并写回未执行的动作，使校正不会在下一次更新时丢失。
根据新计划中归一化后的速度和曲率变化选择长短不同的复用周期，在平稳计划与变化较大的计划之间采用不同刷新频率。
在 ORAD-3D 和 RELLIS-3D 上，模型请求率分别为 6.0% 和 4.8%，3 秒终点位移误差分别降低 18.0% 和 36.7%。
串行回放中，Qwen3-VL 的请求处理成本分别降至原来的 1/16.6 和 1/20.8；对照实验表明，精度收益主要来自跨更新保留状态校正。
